about: (stages agent, 2026-11-20) CPU against CPU in WRESTLEMANIA, both walked up and down the ramp: qa_ringstage 256 (arena_ringstage.c ringstage_qa) puts the two apart every 25 s of match once both are free to walk -- by the ring and on the stage, the other way round, at the aisle's end and at the back of the stage, the other way round -- and each CPU walks to his man. The measure is qa/stage_stuck.py on the run (stuck / shaking seconds: a CPU free to walk, outside the ring, away from his man, getting nowhere); the checks here only that nothing went bad. LOOK: the men on the ramp and the stage, nobody shaking in place.
